subject: Charged twice this month
customer_message: Hi, I see two charges of $80 on my card for March. Can you fix this?
agent_reply: Sorry about that. The second charge was the prorated amount for the 2 members you added on March 12, not a duplicate. It's listed as a separate line on invoice INV-2291 under Settings > Billing > Invoices. If the numbers still look wrong, reply with the last 4 digits of the card and we'll take a closer look.

subject: Slack notifications stopped
customer_message: Our #design channel stopped getting Northpine updates yesterday. Nothing changed on our side.
agent_reply: The channel was renamed and archived-then-unarchived, which removed the Northpine app from it. Typing /invite @Northpine in the channel fixed it. If it happens again, check that the app is still a channel member first.

subject: Lost phone with authenticator
customer_message: I got a new phone and can't log in, my 2FA codes were on the old one. I'm the only owner of our workspace.
agent_reply: Since you're the only Owner, we verified your identity with the last 4 digits of the card on file and the date of your latest invoice, then reset 2FA. You'll be asked to set it up again at your next sign-in. Please save your backup codes this time.

subject: Refund for annual renewal
customer_message: Our annual plan renewed 3 weeks ago but we moved to another tool in January and nobody has logged in since. Can we get a refund?
agent_reply: We checked the activity log and there's been no activity since the renewal, so this qualifies as an accidental renewal under our refund policy (up to 30 days). I've issued a full refund of $1,152 to the original card; it should appear in 5 to 10 business days. Since it's over $500 a support lead approved it.

subject: Board won't open - something went wrong
customer_message: Every time I open the Marketing board in the desktop app I get 'Something went wrong'. Other boards are fine.
agent_reply: This was a corrupted local cache. Help > Troubleshooting > Clear local cache and restarting the app fixed it. Your data is stored on our servers so nothing was lost.

subject: Need VAT number on invoices
customer_message: Can you add our VAT number to the invoices? We're in Germany.
agent_reply: You can add it under Settings > Billing > Billing details and it will show on all future invoices. We can't edit invoices that were already issued, unfortunately.

subject: API returning 429
customer_message: Our script keeps getting 429 errors from the API when syncing tasks.
agent_reply: 429 means you hit the rate limit of 120 requests per minute per token. Read the Retry-After header and wait that many seconds before retrying, or spread the requests across a few minutes. Batching updates also helps.

subject: Downgrade question
customer_message: If we downgrade from Business to Team today do we lose SSO immediately?
agent_reply: No, downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing period, so SSO keeps working until then. After that, members will sign in with email and password, so make sure everyone has a password set before the switch.

subject: Former owner left company
customer_message: Our workspace owner left the company and we can't change billing. I'm an admin.
agent_reply: We emailed the current Owner about the ownership transfer request. If they don't respond within 7 days we'll make you an Owner. In the meantime you can still manage members and boards as an Admin.

subject: Calendar sync not updating
customer_message: I moved a task in Google Calendar but the due date didn't change in Northpine.
agent_reply: Calendar sync runs every 5 minutes, so there can be a short delay. Also, recurring events don't sync back to tasks, and this event was part of a recurring series. Moving a one-off event updates the task as expected.

subject: Workspace read-only
customer_message: Our whole workspace is suddenly read only!! We can't edit anything.
agent_reply: Your last card payment failed 3 times so the workspace went read-only. As soon as the card is updated under Settings > Billing > Payment method we retry the charge immediately and access comes back within a few minutes.

subject: Upload failing at work
customer_message: Attachments upload fine from home but fail on the office wifi.
agent_reply: Your company network is blocking our storage domain. Ask your IT team to allow files.northpine.example and uploads will work again.

subject: Export taking forever
customer_message: I requested a data export 40 minutes ago and haven't received the email.
agent_reply: Exports for large workspaces can take up to 2 hours. You'll get an email with a download link, which expires after 24 hours, so download it soon after it arrives.

subject: Remove member keep tasks
customer_message: If I remove someone who left, what happens to their tasks?
agent_reply: Their tasks stay where they are and get reassigned to Unassigned. Before removing them you can also transfer their private boards to another member so nothing is lost.

subject: Guest pricing
customer_message: Do guests count towards our seat count?
agent_reply: No, guests are free and don't use a seat. They can only see boards they're invited to.

subject: Offline edits conflict
customer_message: Two of us edited the same task while I was on a plane. Whose change won?
agent_reply: The most recent edit wins, and the other version is saved in the task's history, so you can open the task history and copy back anything you need.
